description: This file is a JSON OpenAPI specification for the 'Services.Local.VPN.IPSec.Server' API endpoints, including method definitions, schemas, responses, and events. It describes the API operations for getting, setting, and resetting the IPSec VPN Server configuration and statistics.

methods.name: Services.Local.VPN.IPSec.Server.Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current status and configuration of the IPSec VPN Server, including operational state, configuration parameters, statistics, and interfaces.

methods.name: Services.Local.VPN.IPSec.Server.ResetStatistics
methods.description: Resets the statistical counters of the IPSec VPN Server, such as byte and frame counts.

methods.name: Services.Local.VPN.IPSec.Server.Set
methods.description: Modifies the configuration parameters of the IPSec VPN Server, including enabling/disabling, network interfaces, and server settings like port, authentication, MTU, and max clients.
